OUR REVIEW POLICY

Honest opinions.
Equal treatment.

We publish genuine positive and negative product experiences under the same rules. FI does not rewrite a customer’s words or withhold a review because of its rating. Customers can edit their own review.

What belongs here

Write about your own purchase. Avoid private information, impersonation, harassment, unlawful content or promotional spam. Report a concern to fabricationintelligence@gmail.com with the review title and product.

We may remove content that breaches these rules, with a reason communicated to the reviewer. A product complaint alone is not a reason for removal. We do not offer review incentives. Published names and words are public; account, order, address and payment details remain private.

A research FI Score is separate from a customer star rating. Reviews do not automatically change that score.
